description: web/flowmap/go.mod requires this very repository and pins it with `replace github.com/go-wasmcontainers/relay => ../..`, so the version in the require line is never resolved. Renovate bumping it (relay#5: v0.1.0 -> v0.3.1) changes nothing that builds and fails the artifacts step.

Hold Node at 22 for the flow map job: with node 26 the 'Playwright driver and browsers' step of ci.yml never finishes (relay#11: job in_progress for 4h51m, cancelled; a rerun hung again after 22 minutes, while the same job on main with node 22 takes under 15 minutes). Lift when playwright-go's driver install is shown to run on a newer Node.
